focus: Compare host-side connect behavior between the live qga virtserial channel and a temporary attached virtserialport inside the same VM process.
findings: A temporary attached virtserialport named org.codex.porttest.0 on port 16 accepted a direct host-side AF_UNIX connection through /tmp/regprobe-qga-porttest.sock.
The live qga channel org.qemu.guest_agent.0 on port 2 still returned ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused') on direct host-side AF_UNIX connect.
info qtree showed the temporary codexport port at 'guest off, host off' while the live qga port remained 'guest on, host off'.

This means the persistent refusal is not a generic host-to-QEMU unix socket problem and not a generic virtserialport-attached socket problem either; it is specific to the live qga channel state or qga integration path.
